page.title: eBPF Q&A
page.description: Short, source-grounded answers to recurring questions about eBPF, Linux observability, profiling, runtime extension, and security.
page.bodyHtml:
Short, source-grounded answers to recurring questions about eBPF, Linux observability, profiling, runtime extension, and security.

Questions may begin in public issues, mailing lists, forums, or technical chat communities. Before publication, we rewrite them to remove identities, private deployment details, and wording that could identify the original participant. The answer is then checked against public primary sources. We publish only when the result is useful beyond the original conversation, so this page may remain quiet on days when no question meets that standard.

Latest Answers

  • Can eBPF detect secrets in network traffic without collecting them?

previous.title: Can eBPF detect secrets in network traffic without collecting them?
previous.description: Short answer: yes, but only where plaintext is visible, and the detector must be designed so that raw values never leave that point.
